text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Air Groove! What a terrifying Umamusume!
What a terrifying racer!!
She has overtaken Silence Suzuka—!!
(WOOOOOOAAAAHHHH!!!!)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Senpai...!!

text_block_list.name: Male Fan
text_block_list.text:
"WOOOOOOOO!! Truly amazing~!!
Air Groove, congrats!"

text_block_list.name: Female Fan
text_block_list.text:
*hic*, *sob*, WAAAAHHH!!
Air Groove~! Thank you for the inspiring raceee--!!

text_block_list.name: Cheers
text_block_list.text:
Empress! Empress! Empress!
Empress! Empress! Empress!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
...Yeah.
I—

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: (So... I was truly able to challenge them.)

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: —Air Groove!

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
"Your running was incredible.
...I was completely defeated."

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: ...Thank you, Suzuka.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Because you were running ahead of me...
Because you were stronger than anyone else...

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Today, I was able to challenge it with all my might.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: ...I will never forget today's race for the rest of my life.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: ...Me too.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
"I'll never forget the sight of Air Groove's back
as she passed me."

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
"Let's run again.
Someday, an even greater race than today――"

With deafening cheers at her back,
Air Groove made her return—

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: ...I won. This time for sure.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: ...Yeah.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Thank you... for always believing in me.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: ――Trainer.
